data.text: WEIGHT TRIAL: THE DOOR OPENS WHILE THE PLATE IS HELD
SWITCH TRIAL: BLUE STANDS WHILE OFF, RED WHILE ON
THE SHIP IS KINDLING NOW. CRATES BREAK IF YOU WALK AT THEM
A LAUNCH BOARD OFF THE WRECK. FACE EAST AND STEP ON
WAVE CHIMES. THE SEA RINGS THEM WEST TO EAST - IN ORDER, A GIFT
AN ORCHARD GONE WILD. THE TOLL GATE ASKS FIVE APPLES - TAKE PLENTY
THE TARN FROZE SMOOTH. ONE STEP AND IT CARRIES YOU
SOMETHING GLINTS MID-ICE. THE SLIDE ONLY STOPS WHERE SOMETHING STANDS
THE WARDENS PASSAGE: BLUE STANDS WHILE THE SWITCH SLEEPS, RED WHILE IT WAKES
THE HERMIT KEEPS THE BRIDGE. FIVE APPLES PAYS THE TOLL
THE HERMITS CRYPT. THE WAVE CHIMES KEPT ITS KEY
